paragraphs.text: The Legacy was a collection of artifacts assembled by Urza that work in conjunction to defeat his mortal enemy, Yawgmoth .

In preparation for the inevitable Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria, Urza devised a stratagem to create a champion; Urza's Legacy is more than a collection of artifacts. It is a construct of thought given purpose.

Many of the original artifacts were in Gerrard's possession as a child but were stolen by his adopted brother Volrath , who intended to thwart Gerrard's destiny as part of the Legacy. The first object lost was the Touchstone, stolen as an example by Starke of the things Gerrard possessed, planting the seed for Volrath's plot. Only the Hourglass, worn on his person, and the Null Rod, an object unclear in its operation , remained with Gerrard after this, but ironically, the Hourglass was left in Benalia while Gerrard hunted for the others. The Thran Tome, property of Urza and composed of his construction documentation, was consumed by Karn, and was such was rendered unnecessary to steal. It was the main factor in reshaping the Weatherlight to its final form. Volrath personally took charge of the Skyshaper. Captain Sisay , guardian of the Weatherlight, had already found the Thran Forge, Mind Stone, and Chimeric Sphere before she met and joined with Gerrard. The parts of the Legacy found by Sisay were later lost again when she was abducted.

In 4195 AR, Sisay and Tahngarth tracked the Juju Bubble and located it in the Adarkar Wastes after getting directions from a survivor of Oneah . The bubble was found in an underground dwelling beneath the flats of the wastes, guarded by a war beast left over from the Brothers' War . When the war beast attacked, the Juju Bubble rolled free of the rubble, and Sisay collected it, though first mate Meida lost her life in the scuffle.

The Touchstone itself was used to deactivate Karn , leaving him as a statue in a town square. Karn gripped the Touchstone, and it was locked into his closed palm, so Vuel was unable to retrieve it. Karn stood as a statue for 11 years, until he was picked up by the Weatherlight Crew in 4204 AR in their quest to reunite and rescue Sisay. Gerrard then found a way to reactivate Karn and plucked the Touchstone from his opening grasp.

While the crew was in Llanowar to re-recruit Mirri , an aboroth was about to spring to life, and Gerrard hatched a plan where he brought the Thran Forge onto the deck, strapped it to the rigging with ropes, and then used it to turn the aboroth into an artificial creature. Jumping onto the aboroth's head, Gerrard then used the Touchstone to deactivate it until it shrank and turned to dust. This is what made Tahngarth realize the special connection Gerrard had with the Legacy artifacts.

The Weatherlight Crew traveled to Tolaria to recruit Barrin . Instead, they were asked to bring on board Ertai , the wizard adept. As a test, Hanna asked Ertai to apply his skills on the Chimeric Sphere and the Mind Stone, but Ertai's distaste for artifacts meant he refused, instead casting his abeyance spell on them, which meant Hanna could not activate either. However, when a fog elemental formed from the Pendrell mists attacked them, Ertai ended his abeyance spell and activated the sphere, throwing it in the path of the elemental. Though the fog elemental destroyed the sphere, it was distracted long enough that it faded away harmlessly. Hanna spent the next few days angrily repairing the sphere.

In Rath, Greven il-Vec commandeered the Weatherlight and confiscated the Legacy pieces for Volrath. The Sliver Queen , whom Volrath had previously entrusted the Skyshaper to, was given the other pieces. However, this proved to be a mistake, as Karn was able to relate his existence as disparate parts to the hivemother, and the Queen let Karn take the Legacy from her.

After the arrest of Gerrard , Tahngarth , and Karn in Mercadia, the three women Sisay , Hanna , and Orim struck a deal with the Chief Magistrate of Mercadia City , which allowed them to travel to Saprazzo to negotiate for the Power Matrix. Also in Mercadia were the Bones of Ramos , gifted to the Weatherlight crew by the deified dragon engine. The "Bones" are a collection of Ramos's body parts namely: Skull, Horn, and Tooth, but also Eye and Heart.

Throughout the Weatherlight Saga , it became evident that there was a magical force guiding the assembly of the Legacy. It evolved, incorporating artifacts and beings not originally intended as part of its design. In this way, the Legacy represented an intangible but undeniable guiding force; a fate constructed through artifice.

When the Weatherlight' s plan to use the stored-up white mana in the Null Moon failed to stop Yawgmoth's Black Cloud of Death , Urza told the crew the final secret of the Legacy Weapon. To fire the weapon, they had to combine the various pieces they had gathered in their journey, along with the two stones within Urza's head, Karn's body, and Gerrard's life. Urza and Gerrard died in the activation, but the weapon successfully destroyed Yawgmoth. Karn, now infused with Urza's spark and the power unleashed by the Legacy Weapon, took up his former master's staff and soon left Dominaria.
